identity_rules.git: Commit/tree IDs are typed Git SHA-1 identities. Listing SHA-256 hashes raw git ls-tree -r -z --full-tree bytes, not concatenated source contents. Each submodule has separate content identity.
identity_rules.archive: Archive SHA-256 identifies exact downloaded bytes. Member-listing SHA-256 identifies the separately generated metadata JSON, not extracted source.
identity_rules.authenticity: Public HTTPS/GitHub origins and official vendor link were observed. No independent Git tag/commit signature or publisher archive signature/checksum was verified.
identity_rules.readiness: Content verification does not establish source completeness, compatible binaries, accepted terms, native build capability or qualified runtime behavior.

DXMT CI selects Xcode 16.1 and a Metal shader target; the Pear compiler/SDK/Metal tool versions and permitted distribution boundary are not pinned in Stage 1.
CMake, Meson/Ninja, Python, Clang/linker and native link dependencies require a configuration-specific tool inventory. Observed constraints are not installed-tool validation.
Wine declares optional font/TLS/multimedia/graphics inputs. Select the intended host/guest feature set, decide bundled versus external packages and acquire required versions before source readiness.
The existing source/patch coverage and any missing Darwin integration are Stage 2 questions. No missing patch is invented, authored or marked available.
Outer archive names do not prove ARM64 Preview implementation completeness or code absence. Inspect actual relevant source/patch contents in Stage 2.
